findings.title: FRZ watchdog trust is signer-generic, pathname-based, and cached
evidence: The first existing interpreter-neighbor or repository filename is selected and its pathname trust result is cached for the process lifetime.
The helper accepts any Authenticode Valid signer and does not pin publisher, digest, owner/DACL, link state, or a retained file object.
Popen later reopens the pathname and inherits the ambient environment.
findings.impact: A replaceable validly signed substitute or check/use replacement can execute with the suite token and inherited environment.
mitigations: Protected installed directories reduce writable-path exposure
findings.recommendation: Pin release-manifest publisher and digest, verify owner/DACL/reparse/link state, bind verification through launch, use a minimal environment, invalidate trust on object change, and expose exact trust identity in health.

findings.title: Hermetic status and build launch do not bind to a reviewed binary/script identity
evidence: Frozen status comes from Python attributes and the signature check can target a different first-found binary.
Any valid Authenticode signer is accepted, allowing health 100 without current-image provenance.
trigger_build launches mutable build-hermetic.bat through PATH-resolved cmd immediately after a review message, with no confirmation or digest check.
findings.impact: Packaging provenance can be overstated and an operator click can execute a substituted build script/interpreter under the current token.
mitigations: Expected use is a developer-controlled repository
PowerShell signature command uses an absolute System32 path
findings.recommendation: Resolve the OS current image, verify pinned publisher/digest/owner/DACL and a signed manifest, separate assurance factors, require digest-aware confirmation, and launch the absolute trusted command processor with a minimal environment and non-elevated token.

findings.title: Hardware-Rooted Integrity can report 100 while TPM binding is explicitly absent
evidence: bind_db_key_to_tpm always returns false, including when tpm2-pytss imports.
Successful DPAPI IPC-key protection sets overall module health to 100 and the loop ignores tpm_ok.
findings.impact: A 100 score can be consumed as complete hardware-rooted integrity even though database TPM sealing is absent.
mitigations: The description candidly states TPM sealing is unsupported
findings.recommendation: Split DPAPI IPC custody and TPM sealing/attestation into separate capability metrics and reserve aggregate 100 for proven hardware binding with exact missing-capability links.

findings.title: Judgment subprocess text can certify or promote a control without authenticated success
evidence: Both parsers accept the first stdout/stderr substring VERIFICATION_RESULT without requiring return code zero or a schema, nonce, artifact digest, or recorder receipt.
Intel Sync sets active=true and announces rule promoted although this path installs no rule.
An inert fixture supplied BLOCKED with returncode 9 and the Posture method still followed its certification branch.
findings.impact: Spoofed, stale, shadow-imported, or dependency output can close a live weakness and create false interception assurance.
mitigations: Posture child launch uses the shared hidden-process helper
findings.recommendation: Use an isolated trusted bootstrap and fixed cwd, bound child resources/output, require exit zero, and validate a signed JSON receipt with nonce, technique, build/rule digest, test identity, sequence, and independently verified recorder evidence before certification.

findings.title: Kernel Bridge treats a device-name open as proven sensor health
evidence: CreateFileW and DeviceIoControl lack complete ctypes prototypes.
Any opened fixed-name device leads to unconditional health 100 even if version IOCTL returns no data.
Telemetry IOCTL failure returns silently and does not degrade or reopen; no driver/service/file identity is validated.
findings.impact: An incompatible/substituted device or native ABI failure can silently eliminate telemetry while the bridge claims kernel callbacks are connected.
mitigations: Creating a kernel device usually requires administrative signed-driver authority
No device means health 50 rather than 100
findings.recommendation: Declare all native prototypes, require an exact protocol/capability handshake, pin service and signed driver identity/ACL, track sequence/loss/heartbeat, and degrade/reconnect on every IOCTL/parse failure.

findings.title: Kernel driver inventory can truncate or fail as an apparently complete digest
evidence: Only min(service_count,2048) keys are enumerated, per-key errors are silently skipped, and registry-open failure returns an empty list.
The snapshot carries only driver_count and a digest, with no total, skipped, truncated, or error fields.
Assessment ignores driver collector completeness and can render posture verified at health 100.
findings.impact: Driver-service drift can be absent from an authenticated ledger while consumers treat the inventory as complete.
findings.recommendation: Emit a typed completeness receipt with total/enumerated/skipped/truncated/error counts and epoch, mark incomplete collection UNKNOWN below 100, and paginate boundedly across the full namespace.

findings.title: A basename alone disables Memory Injection Scanner coverage
evidence: Every process named python.exe, chrome.exe, or another JIT-safe basename is skipped before opening/resolving the executable.
The skip contradicts the adjacent comment that basename must not grant trust.
Toolhelp enumeration functions lack HANDLE-safe prototypes, exceptions collapse to an empty map, and health 100 is set before coverage is measured.
findings.impact: An attacker can rename a payload to an allowlisted basename or inject into a real allowlisted process to opt out of the module's central T1055 scan; enumeration failure can blind all coverage while green.
mitigations: Other process/behavior sensors may detect related activity
Suspicious non-allowlisted processes are enriched before response
findings.recommendation: Never skip inspection by basename; use object-bound image identity only for post-scan severity tuning, declare all Toolhelp/HANDLE APIs and close safely, and base health on enumerated/opened/scanned/denied/failed/skipped totals.

findings.title: Memory Time-Machine drops telemetry after permanently deduplicating it
evidence: Hashes are committed before queue admission and forwarded count increments before put_nowait.
queue.Full is silently discarded and the ring overwrites oldest records without loss counters.
A ring-open health 40 is overwritten by the next sweep's tautological reduction_pct >= 0 health 100; opt-in environment values enter plaintext mmap telemetry.
findings.impact: Bursting the bounded queue/ring can erase novel indicators, suppress their retry, and persist secret-like environment values while metrics claim successful forwarding.
mitigations: Default collection avoids known unsafe psutil calls
findings.recommendation: Commit dedup only after durable admission or spool retries, count every loss/high-water/age/error, derive health from complete delivery, apply bounded backpressure, and encrypt/restrict/zeroize persistent strings with secret-key redaction.

findings.title: Mobile response trusts an unpinned external CLI that inherits credentials
evidence: Configured signal-cli is launched with inherited cwd/environment and no absolute path, owner/DACL, reparse, publisher, digest, or retained-object check.
The inherited environment can contain a plaintext portable PIN or same-user-decryptable DPAPI PIN blob.
Receive stdout is trusted for sender/body without return-code, transcript-authentication, or total-output checks; self-test proves only existence and loop health overwrites transient send failure.
findings.impact: A substituted/configured CLI can obtain PIN material, forge the configured sender/command stream, and reach lockdown or token-gated host response under the suite token.
mitigations: Signal E2EE and sender comparison protect the remote channel
Destructive per-alert commands also require tokens
findings.recommendation: Seal an absolute CLI object to pinned digest/publisher/owner/DACL/no-reparse policy, launch with a secret-free minimal environment, authenticate bounded IPC receipts with nonce/return code/job limits, and score health from binary identity plus a verified round trip.

findings.title: Mobile ECO and LOCKDOWN authorization is weaker than the response surface
evidence: ECO changes module cadence after sender comparison without PIN/token.
LOCKDOWN accepts only a fixed four-digit PIN.
Authentication failures have no rate counter, backoff, lockout, replay window, or challenge nonce.
findings.impact: Compromise/spoofing of the configured messaging identity permits immediate monitoring throttling and a bounded 10,000-value online PIN search for lockdown.
mitigations: Signal sender identity is a first factor
KILL/SUSPEND/ROLLBACK additionally require short-lived alert tokens
findings.recommendation: Apply typed authorization to every state change, require fresh cryptographic approval for lockdown, rate-limit and lock out failures, bind tokens to command/target/expiry/nonce, and produce signed change/rollback receipts.

findings.title: IPv4-mapped public IPv6 endpoints are classified as local
evidence: Every string starting with :: is local.
Inert probe: _is_local('::ffff:8.8.8.8') returned true while _is_local('8.8.8.8') returned false.
Local endpoints are discarded before IOC/port/novelty analysis and process novelty is PID-only.
findings.impact: External mapped-IPv4 connections bypass this detector and rapid PID reuse can inherit old novelty state.
mitigations: Other NDR layers may retain visibility
Ordinary IPv4 external endpoints are analyzed
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize via ipaddress, convert ipv4_mapped before explicit loopback/private/link-local policy, normalize zone/endpoints, bind state to process birth time, and add mapped-address fixtures.

findings.title: Packet Sniffer can deadlock on its undrained worker pipe
evidence: The parent polls for exit without reading redirected stdout, then communicates only after exit.
The worker flushes up to 256 JSON lines from inside the capture callback.
A full pipe blocks the worker before timeout completion and the parent has no hard generation deadline or job limits.
findings.impact: Dense matching traffic can indefinitely wedge the enabled capture generation and leave module health stale.
mitigations: Payload values are not emitted and record count is capped
findings.recommendation: Drain concurrently with byte/record caps, enforce a hard parent deadline and tree termination, use isolated trusted child import/cwd plus OS resource limits, and require an end receipt with packet/record/drop/error counts.

findings.title: Forensic capture has no memory, disk, or privacy budget
evidence: Any HIGH event integer PID can be captured and supplied birth metadata is accepted before handle/image verification.
Each committed region is allocated whole and strings are written without region/case/time/free-space/global retention quotas.
Every case copies the operator's full PowerShell history regardless of suspect process.
findings.impact: Large committed regions or repeated serious-event identities can exhaust RAM/disk and collect unrelated credentials/commands.
findings.recommendation: Bind a retained process handle and verified birth/image before admission, require trusted event provenance, chunk reads, enforce all resource/retention quotas, encrypt/ACL/redact evidence, and make shell history separately consented and case-relevant.

findings.title: Unvalidated technique IDs escape the posture remediation directory
evidence: Report mitre values are concatenated into an advisory pathname without strict ID schema or resolved containment.
Unsigned reports are ingested by default in lenient mode.
The forced .advisory.md suffix limits target type but path separators, parent references, and rooted values remain possible.
findings.impact: A writable/imported unsigned report can create or overwrite an advisory-suffixed file outside the remediation directory and poison weakness records.
findings.recommendation: Accept only canonical MITRE IDs, derive a safe slug, resolve and enforce directory containment, use exclusive atomic no-follow writes, and require authenticated reports for filesystem/database mutation by default.

findings.title: Missing posture evidence is rendered as posture clean
evidence: Missing/unreadable/untrusted report processing does not lower health.
Zero database rows in VULNERABLE state is mapped directly to health 100 and note posture clean without feed freshness/authenticity/coverage proof.
findings.impact: First-run, stale, broken, or untrusted evidence can look identical to an evidence-backed clean posture.
findings.recommendation: Model UNKNOWN/STALE/UNTRUSTED/PARTIAL/ASSESSED_CLEAN separately and require a fresh authenticated coverage receipt with source, epoch, expected/observed rounds, and exact failure evidence before 100.

findings.title: PID-only state can suppress new process and LSASS detections after reuse
evidence: Both dedup structures are sets of integer PIDs.
A process can exit and a new generation reuse its PID between snapshots without the PID disappearing from the live set.
Both collectors already obtain create_time but do not key state with it.
findings.impact: A narrow timing window suppresses new-process evaluation or one LSASS alert.
mitigations: Response details include create_time when emitted
findings.recommendation: Key by pid plus normalized create_time/object identity, treat missing birth time as incomplete coverage, expire generation state, and add same-PID/new-birth regression fixtures.

findings.title: File Integrity Monitor uses startup TOFU and silently excludes failed or metadata-preserving changes
evidence: Baseline is in-memory startup state with no authenticated persisted reference or operator approval.
Hash/stat failures silently become absence and ordinary files reuse digest when size and mtime_ns are preserved.
Coverage counts/errors do not drive health, leaving default green possible for empty or partial scans.
findings.impact: Preexisting tampering is enrolled, inaccessible paths disappear, and same-size/mtime modifications to ordinary watched files evade detection.
mitigations: SHA-256 is used when hashing occurs
findings.recommendation: Persist an authenticated reviewed baseline, hash no-follow opened objects with post-read identity revalidation, use journal/event invalidation or randomized full rehash, count all coverage failures/exclusions, and reserve 100 for complete fresh coverage.

findings.title: Large startup entries are monitored by forgeable metadata only
evidence: Files above _MAX_STARTUP_HASH_BYTES receive digest not-hashed-size-bound.
Their drift identity is path, size, and mtime_ns, which content replacement can preserve.
findings.impact: An oversized startup payload can change content without persistence drift detection.
mitigations: Baseline is honestly marked unreviewed at health 75
Other process/file controls may detect execution
findings.recommendation: Stream hashes for all startup executables/scripts under an I/O budget, carry deferred/pending state instead of completeness, bind file IDs/no-follow handles, and postvalidate metadata.

findings.title: Concurrent Evolution workers can lose or corrupt proposal history
evidence: Different technique workers can execute concurrently.
History is an unlocked read/append/full-file write, is not atomic, and swallows all failures.
One worker sets health 100 on completion even if another remains active.
findings.impact: Review evidence for proposals can be lost/partial and lifecycle health can be inaccurate.
findings.recommendation: Serialize or transactionally append history, write atomically with durability, expose failures and run IDs, and compute health from all active workers plus durable receipts.

findings.title: IPC Guard can remain health 100 after its accept loop exits
evidence: accept OSError silently breaks the daemon loop.
The parent never checks accept_thread.is_alive and writes health 100 every five seconds.
Worker-start health 40 can be overwritten on the next parent tick.
findings.impact: The diagnostic authentication listener can be unavailable while its module remains green.
findings.recommendation: Propagate accept-loop terminal state, require listener/worker liveness for green health, restart with bounded backoff, and keep failure latched until an end-to-end challenge succeeds.
